items.title: klight launches Friday May 29, 2026
items.body:
Originally slated for September — pulled forward to **Friday May 29** because the three-world rollout (Solo dev, Startup team, Remote cluster) is on track and shipping early.

- Full-stack Kubernetes envs in two commands
- Postgres, Kafka, Redis spin up in the right order
- Each developer gets their own namespace
- Local minikube, team sync, or remote EKS / GKE / AKS — same CLI

Open source under MIT. Sign up to get notified the moment it ships.
